# change to add a section to put in sets and have it be automatically calculates, remove violin plot, and change radar chart to have archetypes

FINAL CODE:
```{r}
# ── NCAA Women's Volleyball Dashboard ────────────────────────────────────────
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

BASE_URL <- "https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/JeffreyRStevens/ncaavolleyballr/refs/heads/main/data-csv/"
divs  <- c(1)
years <- 2020:2024
build_url <- function(div, year) paste0(BASE_URL, "wvb_playerseason_div", div, "_", year, ".csv")

per_game_stats <- c("Kills","Errors","Total Attacks","Assists","Aces","SErr","Digs","RetAtt", "RErr","Block Solos","Block Assists","BErr","PTS","SrvAtt")

load_data <- function() {
  combos <- expand.grid(div = divs, year = years, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  dfs <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(combos)), function(i) {
    tryCatch({ df <- read.csv(build_url(combos$div[i], combos$year[i]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE); df$Division <- paste0("Div ", combos$div[i]); df }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })
  raw <- bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), dfs))
  raw$Pos[raw$Pos == "MH"] <- "MB"; raw$Pos[raw$Pos == "RS"] <- "OPP"; raw$Pos[raw$Pos == "LS"] <- "L"
  raw$GP <- as.numeric(raw$GP)
  for (col in per_game_stats) if (col %in% names(raw)) { raw[[col]] <- as.numeric(raw[[col]]); raw[[col]] <- ifelse(is.na(raw$GP)|raw$GP==0, NA, raw[[col]]/raw$GP) }
  raw$`Hit Pct` <- as.numeric(raw$`Hit Pct`)

  # ── wOV / wDV (per-set weighted values from linear model coefficients) ──────
  # Replace NA with 0 for the counting stats used in the composite metrics
  count_cols <- c("Kills","Errors","Aces","Digs","RErr","Block Solos","Block Assists","BErr")
  for (col in count_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(raw)) raw[[col]][is.na(raw[[col]])] <- 0
  }
  raw$S_num <- as.numeric(raw$S)
  raw$wOV <- ifelse(
    is.na(raw$S_num) | raw$S_num == 0, NA,
     0.133197 * (raw$Kills         / raw$S_num) +
    -0.063021 * (raw$Errors        / raw$S_num) +
     0.031552 * (raw$Aces          / raw$S_num)
  )
  raw$wDV <- ifelse(
    is.na(raw$S_num) | raw$S_num == 0, NA,
    -0.009673 * (raw$Digs          / raw$S_num) +
    -0.123784 * (raw$RErr          / raw$S_num) +
     0.027278 * (raw$`Block Solos` / raw$S_num) +
     0.052643 * (raw$`Block Assists`/ raw$S_num) +
    -0.011022 * (raw$BErr          / raw$S_num)
  )
  raw
}

pos_labels <- c("OH"="Outside Hitter (OH)","MB"="Middle Blocker/Hitter (MB)","S"="Setter (S)","OPP"="Opposite/Right Side (OPP)","DS"="Defensive Specialist / Libero (DS/L)","L"="Libero (L)")
stat_choices <- c("Kills/G","Errors/G","Total Attacks/G","Hit Pct","Assists/G","Aces/G","Digs/G","Return Attempts/G","Block Solos/G","Block Assists/G","PTS/G")
stat_col_map <- c("Kills/G"="Kills","Errors/G"="Errors","Total Attacks/G"="Total Attacks","Hit Pct"="Hit Pct","Assists/G"="Assists","Aces/G"="Aces","Digs/G"="Digs","Return Attempts/G"="RetAtt","Block Solos/G"="Block Solos","Block Assists/G"="Block Assists","PTS/G"="PTS")
pos_colors <- c("OH"="#00d4b4","MB"="#f5c518","S"="#9b5de5","OPP"="#ff5f57","DS"="#60a5fa","L"="#f97316")

# ── Player archetype definitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
archetypes <- list(
  front = list(
    HH = list(
      icon  = "\U0001F3C6",
      name  = "Complete Weapon",
      short = "High Off / High Def",
      desc  = "Kills efficiently and shuts down opponents at the net. The two-way elite attacker who contributes on every rotation."
    ),
    LH = list(
      icon  = "\U0001F6E1",
      name  = "Defensive Anchor",
      short = "Low Off / High Def",
      desc  = "A dominant blocker who limits opponent attacks but isn't a consistent kill threat. Often a middle who specialises in net defence."
    ),
    HL = list(
      icon  = "\u26A1",
      name  = "Pure Attacker",
      short = "High Off / Low Def",
      desc  = "High kill efficiency with minimal defensive presence. A pin hitter who earns their keep through explosive offense alone."
    ),
    LL = list(
      icon  = "\U0001F527",
      name  = "Role Player",
      short = "Low Off / Low Def",
      desc  = "Below average on both dimensions. Likely a specialist in limited sets or a developing player still building consistency."
    )
  ),
  back = list(
    HH = list(
      icon  = "\U0001F3AF",
      name  = "Floor General",
      short = "High Off / High Def",
      desc  = "Drives offense through aggressive serving and anchors the pass. The complete back-row player who controls both sides of the ball."
    ),
    LH = list(
      icon  = "\U0001F9F1",
      name  = "Defensive Wall",
      short = "Low Off / High Def",
      desc  = "Elite passer and digger with minimal serving threat. The classic defensive specialist or libero who keeps the ball alive."
    ),
    HL = list(
      icon  = "\U0001F525",
      name  = "Serving Threat",
      short = "High Off / Low Def",
      desc  = "Aces create free points but reception is a liability. The serve-specialist brought in specifically to pressure opponents."
    ),
    LL = list(
      icon  = "\U0001F331",
      name  = "Developmental",
      short = "Low Off / Low Def",
      desc  = "Below average in both areas. Likely a younger player building consistency in passing, serving, and defensive reads."
    )
  )
)

plotly_layout <- function(p, ...) {
  p %>% layout(
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font=list(family="Arial, sans-serif",color="#8fa3c0",size=12),
    xaxis=list(gridcolor="rgba(42,58,82,0.6)",zerolinecolor="rgba(42,58,82,0.8)",tickfont=list(family="Arial, sans-serif",size=11,color="#8fa3c0"),titlefont=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=13,color="#8fa3c0")),
    yaxis=list(gridcolor="rgba(42,58,82,0.6)",zerolinecolor="rgba(42,58,82,0.8)",tickfont=list(family="Arial, sans-serif",size=11,color="#8fa3c0"),titlefont=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=13,color="#8fa3c0")),
    legend=list(bgcolor="rgba(22,29,46,0.8)",bordercolor="rgba(42,58,82,0.8)",borderwidth=1,font=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=12,color="#8fa3c0")),
    hoverlabel=list(bgcolor="#0a0e1a",bordercolor="#2a3a52",font=list(family="Arial, sans-serif",size=12,color="#f0f4ff")),
    margin=list(t=20,b=50,l=50,r=20),
    ...
  )
}

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  raw_data <- reactive({
    withProgress(message="Loading NCAA Women's Volleyball data\u2026", value=0.1, { df <- load_data(); incProgress(0.8); df })
  })

  filtered <- reactive({
    df <- raw_data(); req(nrow(df) > 0)
    df[df$Pos %in% input$global_pos, ]
  })

  col_name <- function(label) unname(stat_col_map[label])

  # Players by position count chart
  output$pos_count_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered()
    if (length(input$global_pos) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- df[df$Pos %in% input$global_pos, ]
    count_df <- df %>% count(Pos) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% mutate(color = pos_colors[Pos])
    p <- plot_ly(count_df, x=~reorder(Pos,-n), y=~n, type="bar",
                 marker=list(color=~color, line=list(color="rgba(0,0,0,0)",width=0)),
                 text=~n, textposition="outside",
                 textfont=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=13,color="#f0f4ff"),
                 hovertemplate=~paste0("<b>",Pos,"</b><br>Players: ",n,"<extra></extra>"))
    plotly_layout(p, xaxis=list(title="",gridcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",tickfont=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=14,color="#8fa3c0")), yaxis=list(title="Number of Players"), showlegend=FALSE)
  })

  # Position comparison bar chart
  output$comp_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered()
    if (length(input$global_pos) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- df[df$Pos %in% input$global_pos, ]
    cname <- col_name(input$comp_stat)
    is_rate <- cname == "Hit Pct"
    if (input$comp_scale == "total" && !is_rate) {
      df$plot_val <- df[[cname]] * df$GP
    } else {
      df$plot_val <- df[[cname]]
    }
    y_label <- if (input$comp_scale == "total" && !is_rate)
      sub("/G$", " (season total)", input$comp_stat) else input$comp_stat
    summary_df <- df %>% group_by(Pos) %>%
      summarise(val=if(input$comp_type=="Mean") mean(plot_val,na.rm=TRUE) else median(plot_val,na.rm=TRUE), n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(val))
    p <- plot_ly(summary_df, x=~reorder(Pos,val), y=~val, type="bar",
                 marker=list(color=pos_colors[summary_df$Pos], line=list(color="rgba(0,0,0,0)",width=0)),
                 text=~paste0("n = ",n), textposition="outside",
                 textfont=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=12,color="#8fa3c0"),
                 hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:.3f}<extra></extra>")
    plotly_layout(p, xaxis=list(title=""), yaxis=list(title=paste(input$comp_type, y_label)), showlegend=FALSE,
                  title=list(text=paste(input$comp_type,"\u00b7",y_label,"by Position"),font=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=15,color="#f0f4ff"),x=0.01))
  })

  # Violin plot
  output$violin_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered()
    if (length(input$global_pos) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- df[df$Pos %in% input$global_pos, ]
    cname <- col_name(input$comp_stat)
    is_rate <- cname == "Hit Pct"
    if (input$comp_scale == "total" && !is_rate) {
      df$plot_val <- df[[cname]] * df$GP
    } else {
      df$plot_val <- df[[cname]]
    }
    y_label <- if (input$comp_scale == "total" && !is_rate)
      sub("/G$", " (season total)", input$comp_stat) else input$comp_stat
    df <- df[!is.na(df$plot_val), ]
    hex_to_rgba <- function(hex, alpha=0.15) {
      sprintf("rgba(%d,%d,%d,%.2f)", strtoi(substr(hex,2,3),16L), strtoi(substr(hex,4,5),16L), strtoi(substr(hex,6,7),16L), alpha)
    }
    positions <- sort(unique(df$Pos))
    p <- plot_ly(type="violin")
    for (pos in positions) {
      sub <- df[df$Pos==pos,]
      p <- add_trace(p, y=sub$plot_val, x=rep(pos,nrow(sub)), name=pos, type="violin",
                     box=list(visible=TRUE), meanline=list(visible=TRUE,color="#f5c518"),
                     points="outliers", line=list(color=pos_colors[pos]),
                     fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(pos_colors[pos],0.15),
                     marker=list(color=pos_colors[pos],size=4,opacity=0.5), hoverinfo="y+name")
    }
    plotly_layout(p, xaxis=list(title=""), yaxis=list(title=y_label), showlegend=FALSE, violingap=0.05, violingroupgap=0)
  })

  # Front/back row position groups

  front_row <- c("OH", "MB", "OPP")
  back_row  <- c("S", "DS", "L")

  # Shared plot-building helper
  make_scatter <- function(df_sub, show_means=TRUE, show_quads=TRUE, x_range=NULL, y_range=NULL, row_group=NULL) {
    if (is.null(df_sub) || nrow(df_sub) == 0) return(plot_ly() %>% layout(title="No data"))

    pos_symbols <- c("OH"="circle","MB"="square","S"="triangle-up",
                     "OPP"="diamond","DS"="cross","L"="star")

    mean_wOV <- mean(df_sub$wOV, na.rm=TRUE)
    mean_wDV <- mean(df_sub$wDV, na.rm=TRUE)

    positions <- sort(unique(df_sub$Pos))
    p <- plot_ly(type="scatter", mode="markers")
    for (pos in positions) {
      sub <- df_sub[df_sub$Pos == pos, ]
      if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
      p <- add_trace(p,
        data=sub, x=~wOV, y=~wDV,
        name=pos, legendgroup=pos, showlegend=TRUE,
        text=~paste0("<b>",Player,"</b>",
                     "<br>",Team," · ",Pos," · ",Yr,
                     "<br>wOV: <b>",round(wOV,3),"</b>",
                     "<br>wDV: <b>",round(wDV,3),"</b>",
                     "<br>Sets: <b>",S_num,"</b>"),
        hoverinfo="text",
        marker=list(symbol=pos_symbols[[pos]], color=pos_colors[[pos]],
                    size=8, opacity=0.75,
                    line=list(width=0.5, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)"))
      )
    }

    if (isTRUE(show_means)) {
      ref_x <- if (!is.null(x_range)) x_range else range(df_sub$wOV, na.rm=TRUE)
      ref_y <- if (!is.null(y_range)) y_range else range(df_sub$wDV, na.rm=TRUE)
      p <- p %>%
        add_segments(x=ref_x[1], xend=ref_x[2], y=mean_wDV, yend=mean_wDV,
                     line=list(color="rgba(255,95,87,0.6)",width=1.5,dash="dash"),
                     showlegend=FALSE, hoverinfo="none", inherit=FALSE) %>%
        add_segments(x=mean_wOV, xend=mean_wOV, y=ref_y[1], yend=ref_y[2],
                     line=list(color="rgba(255,95,87,0.6)",width=1.5,dash="dash"),
                     showlegend=FALSE, hoverinfo="none", inherit=FALSE)
    }

    annotations <- list()
    if (isTRUE(show_quads)) {
      xr <- if (!is.null(x_range)) x_range else range(df_sub$wOV, na.rm=TRUE)
      yr <- if (!is.null(y_range)) y_range else range(df_sub$wDV, na.rm=TRUE)
      qs <- list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif", size=10, color="rgba(143,163,192,0.4)")
      quad_labels <- if (!is.null(row_group) && row_group == "front") {
        c("🏆 Complete Weapon", "🛡 Defensive Anchor", "⚡ Pure Attacker", "🔧 Role Player")
      } else if (!is.null(row_group) && row_group == "back") {
        c("🎯 Floor General", "🧱 Defensive Wall", "🔥 Serving Threat", "🌱 Developmental")
      } else {
        c("High Off / High Def", "Low Off / High Def", "High Off / Low Def", "Low Off / Low Def")
      }
      annotations <- list(
        list(x=xr[2], y=yr[2], text=quad_labels[1], xanchor="right", yanchor="top",    showarrow=FALSE, font=qs),
        list(x=xr[1], y=yr[2], text=quad_labels[2], xanchor="left",  yanchor="top",    showarrow=FALSE, font=qs),
        list(x=xr[2], y=yr[1], text=quad_labels[3], xanchor="right", yanchor="bottom", showarrow=FALSE, font=qs),
        list(x=xr[1], y=yr[1], text=quad_labels[4], xanchor="left",  yanchor="bottom", showarrow=FALSE, font=qs)
      )
    }

    xaxis_cfg <- list(title="wOV (weighted Offensive Value per set)")
    yaxis_cfg <- list(title="wDV (weighted Defensive Value per set)")
    if (!is.null(x_range)) xaxis_cfg$range <- x_range
    if (!is.null(y_range)) yaxis_cfg$range <- y_range

    plotly_layout(p,
      xaxis=xaxis_cfg, yaxis=yaxis_cfg, annotations=annotations,
      legend=list(title=list(text="<b>Position</b>",
                             font=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=12,color="#8fa3c0")))
    )
  }

  # Combined scatter — all positions, used on poscomp tab
  # Combined scatter — all positions, used on poscomp tab
  output$scatter_combined <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered()
    df$S_num <- as.numeric(df$S)
    df <- df[!is.na(df$S_num) & df$S_num >= 20, ]
    df <- df[!is.na(df$wOV) & !is.na(df$wDV), ]
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

    p <- make_scatter(df, show_means=TRUE, show_quads=TRUE)

    # Read input, default to 0 if NA (matches model convention)
    gv <- function(id) { v <- input[[id]]; if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) 0 else as.numeric(v) }

    # Only plot custom point if at least one stat was actually entered
    any_entered <- any(!is.na(c(input$cp_kills, input$cp_errors, input$cp_aces,
                                input$cp_digs,  input$cp_rerr,   input$cp_bsolo,
                                input$cp_bassist, input$cp_berr)))
    if (any_entered) {
      # Apply the same model coefficients used in load_data()
      cust_wov <-  0.133197 * gv("cp_kills") +
                  -0.063021 * gv("cp_errors") +
                   0.031552 * gv("cp_aces")

      cust_wdv <- -0.009673 * gv("cp_digs") +
                  -0.123784 * gv("cp_rerr") +
                   0.027278 * gv("cp_bsolo") +
                   0.052643 * gv("cp_bassist") +
                  -0.011022 * gv("cp_berr")

      label <- if (nchar(trimws(input$custom_label)) > 0) trimws(input$custom_label) else "Custom"

      p <- add_trace(p,
        x             = cust_wov,
        y             = cust_wdv,
        type          = "scatter",
        mode          = "markers+text",
        name          = label,
        text          = label,
        textposition  = "top center",
        textfont      = list(family="Arial, sans-serif", size=12, color="#f5c518"),
        hovertemplate = paste0(
          "<b>", label, "</b><br>",
          "wOV: <b>", round(cust_wov, 3), "</b><br>",
          "wDV: <b>", round(cust_wdv, 3), "</b><extra></extra>"
        ),
        marker = list(
          symbol  = "star",
          size    = 16,
          color   = "#f5c518",
          opacity = 1,
          line    = list(width=1.5, color="#0a0e1a")
        ),
        inherit = FALSE
      )
    }
    p
  })


  # ── Radar chart ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  # Reset custom wOV/wDV inputs when button clicked
  observeEvent(input$custom_reset, {
    for (id in c("cp_kills","cp_errors","cp_aces","cp_digs",
                 "cp_rerr","cp_bsolo","cp_bassist","cp_berr")) {
      updateNumericInput(session, id, value=NA)
    }
  })

  output$radar_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered()
    req(length(input$radar_stats) >= 3, length(input$global_pos) >= 1)
    stat_cols  <- stat_col_map[input$radar_stats]
    summary_fn <- if (input$radar_summary == "Mean") mean else median
    radar_df <- df %>%
      filter(Pos %in% names(pos_labels)) %>%
      group_by(Pos) %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(unname(stat_cols)),
                       ~summary_fn(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                .groups = "drop")
    for (col in unname(stat_cols)) {
      rng <- range(radar_df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      radar_df[[col]] <- if (diff(rng) == 0) 0.5 else
        (radar_df[[col]] - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
    }
    # Filter to only the positions the user has selected
    radar_df <- radar_df[radar_df$Pos %in% input$global_pos, ]
    req(nrow(radar_df) >= 1)
    theta_labels <- input$radar_stats
    # Use dashboard palette to stay consistent with other charts
    radar_colors <- c(
      "OH"="#00d4b4", "MB"="#f5c518", "S"="#9b5de5",
      "OPP"="#ff5f57", "DS"="#60a5fa", "L"="#f97316"
    )
    p <- plot_ly(type="scatterpolar", mode="lines+markers", fill="toself")
    for (pos in radar_df$Pos) {
      row    <- radar_df[radar_df$Pos == pos, unname(stat_cols), drop = FALSE]
      values <- c(as.numeric(row), as.numeric(row)[1])
      theta  <- c(theta_labels, theta_labels[1])
      clr    <- radar_colors[[pos]]
      rgb    <- strtoi(c(substr(clr,2,3), substr(clr,4,5), substr(clr,6,7)), 16L)
      p <- add_trace(p,
        r         = values,
        theta     = theta,
        name      = pos,
        line      = list(color = clr, width = 2),
        marker    = list(color = clr, size = 6),
        fillcolor = paste0("rgba(", paste(rgb, collapse=","), ",0.12)")
      )
    }
    # ---- Custom player trace ------------------------------------------------
    # Collect values from dynamic inputs
    custom_vals <- sapply(input$radar_stats, function(lbl) {
      id  <- paste0("custom_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", lbl))
      val <- input[[id]]
      if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(val)
    })

    if (!all(is.na(custom_vals))) {
      # Scale the custom values using the SAME raw ranges as the position averages
      # so the custom point sits correctly relative to the position polygons
      df_raw <- filtered()
      stat_cols_raw <- stat_col_map[input$radar_stats]
      raw_df <- df_raw %>%
        filter(Pos %in% names(pos_labels)) %>%
        group_by(Pos) %>%
        summarise(across(all_of(unname(stat_cols_raw)), ~summary_fn(.x, na.rm=TRUE)), .groups="drop")

      scaled_custom <- mapply(function(val, col) {
        rng <- range(raw_df[[col]], na.rm=TRUE)
        if (is.na(val)) NA_real_
        else if (diff(rng) == 0) 0.5
        else max(0, min(1, (val - rng[1]) / diff(rng)))  # clamp to [0,1]
      }, custom_vals, unname(stat_cols_raw))

      # Only plot if at least one value was entered; use 0 for missing stats
      plot_vals   <- ifelse(is.na(scaled_custom), 0, scaled_custom)
      label       <- if (nchar(trimws(input$custom_label)) > 0) trimws(input$custom_label) else "Custom"
      closed_vals <- c(plot_vals, plot_vals[1])
      closed_theta <- c(theta_labels, theta_labels[1])

      p <- add_trace(p,
        r         = closed_vals,
        theta     = closed_theta,
        name      = label,
        mode      = "lines+markers",
        fill      = "toself",
        line      = list(color="#f5c518", width=2.5, dash="dash"),
        marker    = list(color="#f5c518", size=8,
                         line=list(color="#0a0e1a", width=1.5)),
        fillcolor = "rgba(245,197,24,0.08)"
      )
    }
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    p %>% layout(
      polar = list(
        bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        radialaxis = list(
          visible   = TRUE,
          range     = c(0, 1),
          tickvals  = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
          ticktext  = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1"),
          gridcolor = "rgba(42,58,82,0.6)",
          linecolor = "rgba(42,58,82,0.8)",
          tickfont  = list(family="Arial, sans-serif", size=10, color="#8fa3c0")
        ),
        angularaxis = list(
          gridcolor = "rgba(42,58,82,0.6)",
          linecolor = "rgba(42,58,82,0.8)",
          tickfont  = list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif", size=12, color="#8fa3c0")
        )
      ),
      legend = list(
        title       = list(text="<b>Position</b>",
                           font=list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=12,color="#8fa3c0")),
        bgcolor     = "rgba(22,29,46,0.8)",
        bordercolor = "rgba(42,58,82,0.8)",
        borderwidth = 1,
        font        = list(family="Arial Narrow, Arial, sans-serif",size=12,color="#8fa3c0")
      ),
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font          = list(family="Arial, sans-serif", color="#8fa3c0"),
      hoverlabel    = list(bgcolor="#0a0e1a", bordercolor="#2a3a52",
                           font=list(family="Arial, sans-serif",size=12,color="#f0f4ff")),
      margin        = list(t=20, b=20, l=20, r=20)
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
